text:
maria: Quick question for private deploys — customer wants a FIPS + HSM runtime. Two asks: minimal RBAC for runtime->KMS shim, a deny-by-default netpol pattern that still allows host-agent talk, conntrack/sysctl guidance, and where to stash an HSM incident runbook.

devin: Keep it namespace-scoped. ServiceAccount per-runtime, Role with only secrets:get and mapped external role for Encrypt/Decrypt (Sign if attestation needed). Avoid cluster-admin.

ash: Prefer unix domain socket for local shim to avoid conntrack. If shim is TCP on host, run it in a dedicated namespace/DaemonSet labeled app=kms-proxy and only allow egress to that label.

sre-jordan: Netpol pattern: default deny egress, add one egress rule to namespaceSelector role=kms-agent + podSelector app=kms-proxy. If agent runs hostNetwork, scope egress to node CIDR.

devin: Conntrack note: rootless containers + short-lived TCP connects can exhaust nf_conntrack. Recommend UDS or long-lived pooled connections. Suggest onboarding sysctl: net.netfilter.nf_conntrack_max=131072 as a baseline.

ash: Audit events: emit structured JSON events {event_type, principal, resource_id_hashed, action, outcome, ts}. Use SHA2-256 for hashing in FIPS mode. Never log keys or plaintext ciphertext.

sec-bot: Policy reminder: changes to kms client must pass kms-client risk review: https://redwood.internal/policies/kms-client-change

ops-liz: Store HSM runbook in private repo ops/runbooks/hsm-fallback.md. Playbook: fail-closed for new decrypts -> alert infra & customer HSM ops -> enable software-fallback behind feature flag -> rotate ephemeral keys if integrity is suspect.

maria: Can someone drop two tiny examples we can paste into onboarding (RBAC + NetworkPolicy)?

sre-jordan: Copy-paste minimal examples (trim and adapt per customer):
- RBAC: Role: namespace customer-runtime; rules: - resources: ["secrets"] verbs: ["get"] ; RoleBinding -> runtime-sa.
- NetworkPolicy: podSelector app=runtime; policyTypes: [Egress]; egress -> to namespaceSelector role=kms-agent + podSelector app=kms-proxy port 1812.

devin: Test plan for conntrack: synthetic load that opens/closes many short TCP connections (10k/min) from rootless runtime to agent; monitor /proc/net/nf_conntrack, conntrack metrics, and trigger alerts.

maria: Great — ops/liz will author the runbook + onboarding PR. If folks can volunteer a test cluster for the conntrack run, ping me. :raised_hands:
